# NativeExpress

> A commercial React Native and Expo boilerplate. You buy a licence and receive the
> source on GitHub: a working iOS and Android app with authentication, Postgres,
> payments, push, analytics and three AI features already wired together.

NativeExpress is a paid starter kit you own and edit, not a library you install or a
framework you build against. It is bought once, not subscribed to, and every future
version is included. This page and the public repository at
https://github.com/reactnative-boilerplate/react-native-boilerplate describe the
product; the source code is in a private repository that buyers get access to.

Licences are one-time and priced in USD: Solo $229 (1 seat), Startup $599 (up to 5
seats), Agency $1,124 (up to 10 seats). Every tier allows commercial use and includes
lifetime updates.

The stack is Expo SDK 57, React Native 0.86, React 19.2 and TypeScript 6.0. Supabase
provides Postgres, authentication and edge functions. RevenueCat handles in-app
purchases and Superwall the paywalls. OneSignal sends push, PostHog collects analytics
and Sentry reports crashes. The AI features (chat, image generation, camera scan) run
on OpenRouter through the Vercel AI SDK. Styling is Uniwind, which is Tailwind CSS v4
for React Native, with HeroUI Native components.

The current release is 2.1.1, published 2026-10-02.
